towerdefense_type.instructions: Which Tower Defense role best describes the unit's main contribution in the selected upgrade configuration? Choose exactly one. Prefer the role that explains why the unit is deployed, not its weapon appearance or original game class.

criteria.basic_dps: Deals reliable direct damage without a stronger specialization in the other roles.
criteria.sniper: Prioritizes long-range, accurate, high-impact attacks against selected targets.
criteria.rapid_fire: Deals sustained damage through very frequent attacks or dense projectile volleys.
criteria.splash: Clears groups through explosions, area attacks, bouncing attacks, or chain damage.
criteria.slow: Primarily reduces movement speed or repeatedly pushes enemies backward.
criteria.support: Primarily improves other units through buffs, detection, discounts, or cooldown reduction.
criteria.economy: Primarily generates money, resources, or recoverable economic value.
criteria.tank_killer: Specializes in high-health enemies, armored enemies, bosses, or large single-target bursts.
criteria.status: Primarily applies hard control or harmful effects such as stun, freeze, burn, poison, or damage vulnerability.
criteria.summoner: Primarily deploys autonomous attackers, minions, or persistent traps that deal damage or control enemies.
